'''Ștefan Urâtu''' (born 9 January 1951) is a Moldovan politician.

==Biography==
Ștefan Urâtu studied at the Veterinary and Zootechnics College from Căușeni, [[Grigoriopol sub-district, Transnistria|Grigoriopol rayon]] (1966–1967). He performed compulsory military service in the [[Soviet army]] (1969–1972), in [[Budapest]], Hungary. In 1977, he graduated from the department of physics and mathematics of the State Pedagogical Institute in [[Tiraspol]], Moldova. Between 1988 and 1992, Ștefan Urâtu was pro-dean of the department of physics and mathematics of the [[Tiraspol State University]]. He has published over 30 scientific articles in the area of the physics of metals and applying [[radioactive isotopes]].<ref>[http://www.e-democracy.md/en/elections/parliamentary/2009/opponents/uritu-stefan/ Biographical Data]</ref>

Ștefan Urâtu was a [[Popular Front of Moldova]] member of the Republican Council in the Tiraspol section between 1989 and 1992. He was politically detained together with the "[[Ilașcu Group]]" between 2 June and 21 August 1992.

In 1990, he founded the first non-governmental association—the Committee for Human Rights from Transnistria in the Tiraspol-based section of the Popular Front. Between 1993 and 2009, he was the chairman of the [[Helsinki Committee for Human Rights]] in Moldova (elected in 1993, 1998, 2006).<ref>[http://www.e-democracy.md/en/elections/parliamentary/2009/opponents/uritu-stefan/ Biographical Data]</ref>

Ștefan Urâtu was an adviser of [[Mihai Ghimpu]] after 12 February 2010.<ref>[http://www.azi.md/ro/story/9316 Ştefan Urâtu - consilierul lui Ghimpu pe probleme politice]</ref> He was a deputy in the [[Parliament of Moldova]] in 2010.<ref>[http://www.info-prim.md/?x=0&y=32477 Ştefan Urâtu renunţă la funcţia de consilier prezidenţial în favoarea mandatului de deputat]</ref><ref>[http://hotnews.md/articles/view.hot?id=3885 Ştefan Urâtu nu va mai fi consilier prezidenţial, dar deputat]</ref>

He was decorated, by a [[President of Moldova|presidential]] decree, with Moldova's highest [[state decoration]] – the [[Order of the Republic (Moldova)|Order of the Republic]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.azi.md/en/story/13001 |title=Members of "Ilascu Group", awarded "Ordinul Republicii" |access-date=2010-08-06 |archive-date=2010-09-08 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100908221335/http://www.azi.md/en/story/13001 |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref>[[Vocea Basarabiei]], [http://www.voceabasarabiei.net/index.php/stiri/politica/10033-un-grup-de-persoane-au-fost-decorate-cu-ordinul-republicii Un grup de persoane au fost decorate cu „Ordinul Republicii”] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110724123814/http://www.voceabasarabiei.net/index.php/stiri/politica/10033-un-grup-de-persoane-au-fost-decorate-cu-ordinul-republicii |date=2011-07-24 }}</ref>

Since 2011, Ștefan Urâtu was Vice-President of the [[Central Electoral Commission of Moldova|Central Electoral Commission]] of the Republic of Moldova.<ref>{{cite web|title=Componenţa Comisiei|url=http://cec.md/index.php?pag=news2&opa=view&id=113&tip=componenta|publisher=Comisia Electorală Centrală a Republicii Moldova|accessdate=19 July 2013|language=Romanian|quote=Dr. Ştefan Urîtu - Vicepreşedintele Comisiei Electorale Centrale}}</ref>
